regression_checks.read_only: OK - git subcommands still only --version, for-each-ref, rev-list, log; N1 guard uses only realpath/read/dirname/pwd and runs before mkdir
regression_checks.deterministic: OK - LC_ALL=C, TZ=UTC, sorted outputs; extra keys pinned; guard only gates start
regression_checks.target_matching: unchanged - hit(), hyphen list, four places, +-column logic; N3 strip touches only the path
regression_checks.m_time: unchanged - separate author/committer UTC dates, RECORDING_ORDER labels
regression_checks.hashing: unchanged - finish() SHA256SUMS, SELF resolved before any cd
regression_checks.method_note: r0 script not present; regression check by line-by-line reading of r1 against REVIEW-r0 line references (offsets consistent with the changelog's stated edits only)

nonblocking.summary: GIT_COMMON_DIR (and legacy GIT_GRAFT_FILE) not unset; git honours GIT_COMMON_DIR without GIT_DIR, which can redirect refs/objects and bypass the N1 guard; PROTOCOL-A section 7 'the other repository-location variables' overstates this.

N1 guard recognises only .git entries: cwd inside a bare repository or a git directory with no enclosing .git entry is not protected; from a linked worktree OUT may lie in the main work tree (harmless). 'exactly as git discovery does' should be softened.

Unpinned local config can still change the added-line set (e.g. diff.submodule=diff emits '+' submodule content lines; info/attributes or core.attributesFile can mark files binary). Covered by the general section 7 disclosure; pin -c diff.submodule=short.

Root-first consequences not stated: top-level build config (vite.config.js, tailwind.config.js) is P-OTHER; compiled assets under public/ are P-CODE; manifest-only commits (composer.json/package.json) with a message hit are MENTION-ONLY.

Open from REVIEW-r0 and explicitly not addressed in r1 (T2 right boundary, T1 range/list forms, removal/revert counted as execution, unchecked pipeline stages, shallow clones, refs/stash, verbatim ref names/paths, JSON escaping, C5 wording, hyphen-list omissions, ref names not searched).
